_meta.purpose: Cifra multi-instrumento de Black. Estrutura: instruments contem diagramas de acordes por instrumento (violao 6 cordas, ukulele 4 cordas, piano notas); content eh o texto ChordPro compartilhado entre os 3.
_meta.source: Ultimate Guitar Pro - 3 PDFs oficiais (violao + ukulele + piano)

title: Black
content:
{section: Intro}
[E] [A] [E]
[A] [E]   [A] [E]
  Hey, oh

{section: Verso 1.1}
[E]Sheets of empty [A]canvas
        [E]Untouched sheets of clay
[A]  [E]Were laid spread out before me
   [E]As her body once did

{section: Verso 1.2}
[E]All five hori[A]zons
        [E]Revolved around her soul
[A]As the earth to the sun
[E]Now the air I [A]tasted and breathed
   [E]Has taken a turn

{section: Pré-refrão}
    [C]Ohohoh and all I taught her was [Em]everything
    [C]Ohohoh I know she gave me all that she [Em]wore
         [D]And now my bitter hands

{section: Refrão}
            [C]Chafe beneath the clouds
                [Em]Of what was everything
            [D]Oh the pictures have
            [C]All been washed in black
                [Em]Tattooed everything

{section: Verso 2}
[E]I take a walk out[A]side
        [E]I'm surrounded by
              [A]Some kids at play
[E]I can feel their [A]laughter
   [E]So why do I sear

{section: Pré-refrão}
    [C]Oh, oh and twisted thoughts that spin
            [Em]Round my head
I'm spinning
    [C]Oh, I'm spinning
                            [Em]How quick the sun can, drop away
            [D]And now my bitter hands

{section: Refrão}
            [C]Cradle broken glass
                [Em]Of what was everything
                [D]All the pictures had
            [C]All been washed in black
                [Em]Tattooed everything
            [D]All the love gone bad
                [C]Turned my world to black
                    [D]Tattooed all I see
                [C]All that I am
                    [Em] [D]All I'll be
Yeah

{section: Solo}
[C] [Em] [D]
[C] [Em]
 I know someday you'll have a beautiful life
    [D]I know you'll be a star
            [C]In somebody else's sky
                [Em]But why
Why
        [D]Why can't it be    [C]
Why can't it be mine
[Em] [D] [C] [Em]
[D] [C] [Em] [D]
[C] [Em] [D] [C]
[Em] [D] [C] [Em]
[D] [C] [D] [C]

{section: Outro}
[Em] [D] [C] [Em]
[D] [C]

{section: Outro (Fade Out)}
[Em] [D] [C]
